title: Book 5 — Terpsichore, Chapter 17
paragraphs: So those of the Paeonians who had been conquered were being taken to Asia. Meanwhile Megabazus, after conquering the Paeonians, sent as envoys to Macedonia seven Persians who, after himself, were the most respected men in the army. These were being sent to Amyntas to demand earth and water for King Darius. From Lake Prasias the way into Macedonia is very short: first, right by the lake, there is the mine from which, after this time, a talent of silver came in regularly every day to Alexander; and past the mine, when you have crossed the mountain called Dysorum, you are in Macedonia.
